messages:
opsbot: INCIDENT: ingress-prod high 5xx rate detected — 5xx = 9.2% (5m)
opsbot: Pager: severity=page, runbook=https://runbooks.redwood/internal/ingress-5xx

emma: Oncall emma here, looking.

sanjay: I see spike in Grafana -> ingress-lb cluster: env-lb-prod, spikes to 10% 502/503, mostly eu-west1.

marco: logs show upstream connection failures: "upstream reset by peer" and 503 from envoy on gateway route "/v1/infer". Sample:
```
[2026-03-15T10:01:12Z] envoy proxy: upstream reset, cluster: model-backend-v2
[2026-03-15T10:01:14Z] envoy proxy: 503 service unavailable
```

emma: Any recent LB/Envoy config changes? PR 4782 rolled last night touching retry policy and circuit breaker thresholds.

marco: Yup PR 4782 set retry_on to "5xx,connect", and increased max_connections to 200. That allowed aggressive retries to backend causing overload.

lucy: Impact: ~12% of user requests failed for infer endpoints; top customers show errors, CS pinged about degraded throughput. Estimate: 6 customers with >30% errors, and ~4k failed requests/min at peak.

emma: Plan — quick rollback of retry policy, disable retries at gateway to stop amplification. Then tune outlier detection. Who can patch envoy config now?

sanjay: I can patch. Quick command to disable retries on route:
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap envoy-config --type=json -p='[ {"op":"replace","path":"/routes/0/retry_policy","value": null } ]'
```

marco: Also reduce route weight to fallback pool: set weight 0 for model-backend-v2 -> divert to model-backend-v1.

emma: Execute both. I'll coordinate with CS for customer messaging. @customer-success-bot please draft advisory.

customer-success-bot: Draft: "We're investigating elevated error rates affecting generation requests in eu-west1. We're applying mitigations now and will update in 15 minutes." :warning: 

sanjay: Patch applied, disabled retries, and reduced weight. Watching metrics.

(2 minutes)

marco: 5xx dropping — from 9% -> 2.1% within 3m. Envoy logs show fewer upstream resets.

lucy: Customer impact improving. CS will send update.

emma: Keep monitoring for 30m, open post-incident for config rollback review and test harness for retry safety.

sanjay: Filing incident ticket: INC-2026-042, linking PR 4782 and configmap diff.

marco: Notes: root cause likely retry amplification + backend capacity mis-sizing. Action items: revert PR or add conservative retry budget, add circuit breaker break-before-retry, add autoscale for model-backend-v2, update runbook.

emma: Closing page for now, will keep thread for postmortem. Thanks all :heart: 

opsbot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: ingress-prod 5xx back to normal (<1%) — duration ~18m
